description: Builds a robots.txt file: allow everything, block everything or custom Allow and Disallow paths, with sitemap URLs, a crawl delay and switches that block AI crawlers such as GPTBot and ClaudeBot. Returns the file and findings.

allow.description: Paths to allow in custom mode, each starting with /.

block_ai_bots.description: AI crawlers to block completely. One of: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider.

disallow.description: Paths to block in custom mode, each starting with /.

mode.description: allow lets every crawler in (default), block shuts them all out, custom uses disallow and allow paths.

name: robots_txt_generator
title: robots.txt generator
